We still want Redwood to lead the 25-minute exec segment and then stay on for a deeper 45-minute technical follow-on if possible.

Also attaching a short internal agenda so you can see who will be on. We intend to have Kyle + Head of Engineering + Procurement on the call.

Let me know which of those two earlier slots work and whether a Redwood EIR/SE should cover the deep tech segment or if your VP can join at the earlier time. If it helps, we can also accept a 2-person exec handoff (VP + SE) instead of the full VP panel.

Appreciate the flexibility — we want to keep momentum on the PoC timeline.

Best,
Tim Bolton
Director, Partnerships | TimeBridge

- 9:25–10:15am PT: Tech deep-dive (Marissa + SE) — architecture, data handling, SSO/KMS notes

If 9:00 is a hard no, 10:30 is our fallback and we can shift people accordingly.

I’ve tentatively held 9:00am PT on our calendar pending your confirmation. Once you confirm, we’ll send an updated invite (with the deck attached: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pptx).
